name: NutriLoupe
subtitle: Ingredient & symptom journal
promotionalText: Keep ingredient labels and a personal food-and-symptom journal with transparent association counts.
description:
Keep ingredient labels and a personal food-and-symptom journal with transparent association counts.

Import an ingredient label and review extracted ingredients against the original.

See a provisional processing explanation and an explicitly unvalidated preference heuristic.

Correct label text or journal time, log repeated meals independently and export a meal-and-symptom CSV. Explore the 14-day association chart.

Inspect the observed counts and limitations instead of treating associations as causes.

Search your saved library locally. Export a complete portable backup with password encryption; imports add new identifiers and keep existing edited records.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Document processing and supported Apple Intelligence generation run on device. Health records stay on device with no automatic CloudKit synchronization. There is no developer-operated account, advertising, analytics backend or third-party AI API. Supported local/text workflows remain available when a model or speech language is unavailable.

Complete health-record archives require a passphrase of at least 12 characters. Use a trusted destination and keep a backup before changing devices or deleting the app.

FREE AND PRO
Includes five successful on-device AI actions in total per app. Reading, editing, exporting and backing up saved records remain available without Pro. Pro unlocks additional actions through monthly or annual subscriptions, or a separate lifetime purchase. App Store prices, eligibility and subscription terms are displayed before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled in App Store settings.

Educational organization only. This app does not diagnose conditions, certify allergens or food safety, or recommend treatment or an elimination diet. Ingredient-only processing classification is provisional. Symptom associations do not establish causation; consult a qualified clinician for health decisions.
